name: tilttek/escape-room-bundle
description: tilttek/escape-room in Symfony: rooms, bookings, a host console, live hint screens, countdowns that end on time and a leaderboard by consent.

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the tables of the escape rooms to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a member's games, results, bookings and screen messages with the rest of their account
suggest.phil/reservation: To book the sessions of the rooms as intervals of a bookable resource, kept in Doctrine DBAL
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes Card, Badge, Button, Alert and Celebration the screens are built of, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/console: For the command that ends the games whose countdown reached zero
suggest.symfony/mercure-bundle: For the hub the hint screen is told of each move of the console
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: To limit the guesses of a team across the processes of the application
suggest.symfony/scheduler: To end the games whose countdown reached zero from Symfony Scheduler
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: For the controllers of the host console and of the hint screen
suggest.symfony/translation: To translate the texts of the screens
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the screens, built of the recipes of a kit of the Symfony UX Toolkit
